subject: Error in install.packages : type == "both" can only be used on Windows or a CRAN build for macOS

messages.author: 26c971075f8aedcc
messages.subject: Error in install.packages : type == "both" can only be used on Windows or a CRAN build for macOS
parts:
Hi,

FYI: I tried to install INLA using the recommended approach from https://www.r-inla.org/download-install and get the following error on my Mac (uname -a gives me Darwin S37-0Y3YJF6V 23.6.0 Darwin Kernel Version 23.6.0: Mon Jul 29 21:14:04 PDT 2024; root:xnu-10063.141.2~1/RELEASE_ARM64_T8122 arm64):

> opt <- options()
> options(pkgType="both")
> install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep=TRUE)
Installing package into ‘/usr/local/lib/R/4.4/site-library’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Error in install.packages : type == "both" can only be used on Windows or a CRAN build for macOS

I have installed R via homebrew and this is the version

> R.version
               _                          
platform       x86_64-apple-darwin23.4.0  
arch           x86_64                     
os             darwin23.4.0               
system         x86_64, darwin23.4.0       
status                                    
major          4                          
minor          4.1                        
year           2024                       
month          06                         
day            14                         
svn rev        86737                      
language       R                          
version.string R version 4.4.1 (2024-06-14)
nickname       Race for Your Life  

If I restart R and run just

> install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep=TRUE)

Then the installation proceeds.

Gregor
